_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Xogo co i altri inte na {width}x{height} a griglia.
Ti xe xogador {player_id}. Moviłi vałidi: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Ojetivo: sopravivere a tutti i altri. Le trase are mortałi; i urti contro el muro i fa morire; i scontri testa-coda i fa morire tuti do.

game_action.invalid_death: El xugador {player_id} el xe morto par via de na mossa invalida.

outcome.survived_win: El xugador {player_id} el xe sopravvissù; tuti i altri se ga schiantà.
outcome.all_crashed: Tutti i zugadori xe cascai in simultanea.
outcome.outlived: El xugador el ga vissù più de tuti i altri.
outcome.turn_limit: El limite de turno xe rivà: vinse chi che ga vissù più a lungo.
